title: Korean-Style Chicken, Garlic and Ginger Rice Soup
summary: A soothing Korean-inspired chicken and rice soup with tender shredded chicken, soft rice, plenty of garlic and warming ginger. It is gentle enough for a cold evening but savoury and satisfying for dinner.

ingredients.name: spring onions, sliced, whites and greens separated

steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the spring onion whites, garlic and ginger, and cook for 1–2 minutes until fragrant but not browned.
Add the chicken thighs and turn them in the aromatics for 2 minutes, just until the outside starts to turn opaque.
Add the rinsed rice, carrot, vegetable stock, tamari, salt and black pepper. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a gentle simmer.
Cover partly and simmer for 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the rice is very soft and the chicken is cooked through and tender.

Lift the chicken onto a board, shred it with two forks, then return it to the pan. Simmer for another 5 minutes until the soup is slightly thickened and porridge-like; add a splash more water if you prefer it looser.
Stir in the sesame oil. Taste and adjust with a little more salt if needed.
Serve hot, topped with the spring onion greens and sesame seeds.
